name: Moonpath
description: The moon over open water and the flickering road of light it lays toward you; by day a low sun and a warm path.

props.name: phase
props.description: Phase of the moon from 0 to 1: 0 is new, 0.25 first quarter, 0.5 full, 0.75 last quarter. It sets the lit part of the disc and the brightness of the path. By day the sun is always whole.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for the movement of the water and the flicker of the glints.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the scene. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered above the scene. The path leans toward the pointer, as if you were walking along the shore.
